model_selection: All A/B seed endpoints are fixed by the frozen training config. Test is run once after validation_freeze.json exists; test scores never choose a seed, checkpoint, loss weight or decode setting.

caption_metrics.reference_policy: all original captions for each of the 2990 test videos

retrieval.name: captioning-test2990 matched retrieval, not MSR-VTT 1K retrieval
retrieval.text_to_video_target: originating video ID for each original caption
retrieval.video_to_text_positive: any original caption of the query video
retrieval.text_representation: L2-normalized masked mean of frozen GPT-2 token embeddings
retrieval.text_truncation_rule: fail if any original query needs 128 or more GPT-2 tokens; no silent truncation
retrieval.ranking: cosine similarity, descending; deterministic ID-order tie rule
retrieval.exact_caption_collision_policy: retain originating-video target; disclose ambiguous repeated strings

test_feature_policy: Build test frozen ViT features only after validation_freeze.json; verify direct/cache equality without reading model quality metrics during setup.
failure_policy: Preserve predictions, logs and original failure; rerun only for a documented implementation error with unchanged training/config and disclose the correction.
